deliverables.VmLifecycleService: Composed supervised lifecycle service wrapping FirecrackerBackend with idempotency, serialization, quota, reconciliation, readiness gating, and audit
deliverables.RequestKey: Deduplication key for idempotent operations (create/start/stop scoped by operation+subject+nonce)
deliverables.SupervisorState: Tracks process health, reconciles supervisor death to Failed state
deliverables.is_guest_not_ready: Service-level typed classifier for guest-readiness failures

test_coverage.idempotency: create/start/stop idempotent by request key; duplicate replays cached outcome
test_coverage.serialization: 8 concurrent starts with same key serialize to 1 backend start
test_coverage.quota: max_vms and max_vcpus enforced before mutation; QuotaExceeded returned
test_coverage.reconciliation: supervisor death detected on status check; VM driven to Failed
test_coverage.readiness: guest-not-ready prevents Running state; VM driven to Failed
test_coverage.audit: exactly one audit event per mutating request; denied/errored requests audited
